enforcement_history: Sustained enforcement campaign from 2017. Stopped a self-published book, and forced withdrawals by AltRight.com, Arktos, r/The_Donald and The Daily Stormer. Furie v. Infowars settled June 2019 for $15,000 plus an agreement to stop selling and destroy stock. The court expressly refused to hold that meme-ification diminishes the author's copyright.
curatorial_note: Two hazards, not one. Active author enforcement, plus ADL hate-symbol listing that carries reputational risk for a museum. Treat as placeholder-only.
